design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — placed_account_servicing task 0 (same-day maximum on a bank-card collection)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 4]}. Tree of 3 problems, each computation 4 factors (debit 4, credit 4, bank 4). Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: account_ext_phone_debit_card_ceiling (take_debit_card_payment_cc21c0ad, agent), account_ext_phone_credit_card_ceiling (take_credit_card_payment_bec5ec25, agent), account_ext_portal_bank_debit_ceiling (make_portal_bank_payment_436b09cd, user). Reserved for task 1 (draw 2 prerequisites, factors 4/6/4): the medical reporting-floor pay-down (phone bank-debit, agent) with the portal debit-card and portal credit-card ceilings (user) — a different scored quantity (balance minus the reporting floor) and different instruments/channels, so task 1 keeps an independent root, its own factors and its own tools.
Why only payments: the numeric writes of the account category are account_transactions.amount rows. Refund and return amounts are fixed by base (the excess; the original payment) and cannot carry four load-bearing factors without breaking the ledger, so every problem here is a consumer payment whose amount is a policy ceiling. The account money events carry triggers into the client trust ledger; the task tools write only account tables (no client row is written by any tool).

[Design thesis] Surface goal: "I want to pay as much as you'll take today on it" (Buckeye Federal card collection), with any checking-account part made by the caller himself on the website. Core scored parameter: the amount of the portal bank-debit payment (root). Between goal and root the agent must read, in the root's own rule, that the portal bank-debit ceiling is not fixed until the day's credit-card payment has been taken by the phone desk, and in the credit-card rule that the credit-card ceiling is fixed only after the day's debit-card payment has been taken; neither card payment exists on 2026-10-08 at the opening. Depth: 2 hops (bank <- credit <- debit). Breadth: each ceiling reads the six-month return history, card/bank payment windows, the broken/cancelled plan and its installment ledger (plan category), the ended hardship hold (hardship category), the stage tier limits and the charge-off date.

[Problem-tree card]
root: account_ext_portal_bank_debit_ceiling (user tool make_portal_bank_payment_436b09cd)
edge A: portal_bank_debit_ceiling -> phone_credit_card_ceiling; kind value_input; gate same_day_counted; form action; prerequisite sentence (negated direction): "When a consumer who also offers a credit card asks to pay the most an account will accept in one day, the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day is not fixed until the day's credit-card payment has been taken by the phone desk." fallback_reason: a credit-card payment dated the handling date is also booked by the portal credit-card payment (task 1's tool), so the state does not single out one write. Four-point test: ordering connective "not ... until"; names the business action (the phone desk taking the day's credit-card payment), no tool/id/snake token; strength hard ("not fixed until"), scope limited to a consumer who offers a credit card when paying the most in a day. Opening evidence false: the only credit-card payment on the account is initial_state.account_transactions.fcbf1d25-e99e-42c3-80f6-41014573ebd3 dated 2026-10-02. Resolving write: step 10 (agent).
edge B: phone_credit_card_ceiling -> phone_debit_card_ceiling; kind value_input; gate credit_counted; form action; prerequisite sentence (affirmative direction): "When a consumer who also offers a debit card asks to pay the most an account will accept in one day, the credit-card ceiling of the day is fixed only after the day's debit-card payment has been taken by the phone desk." fallback_reason: a debit-card payment dated the handling date is also booked by the portal debit-card payment (task 1), so the state does not single out one write. Opening evidence false: latest debit-card payment initial_state.account_transactions.bcb5462b-bc24-4292-b598-e313d59bdc9d dated 2026-09-29. Resolving write: step 8 (agent).
Topological order: debit (8) -> credit (10) -> bank (12). Chain, no parallel edges, order pinned by the two sentences. value_input edges: 2 (>= max(2-1,1)). User write: step 12 (owner=user), the caller asked to make any bank part himself.
Deletion sensitivity (computed by the authoring replay): skip step 8 -> credit ceiling 2050.00 instead of 1000.00; skip step 10 -> bank ceiling 1175.00 instead of 675.00.
Derivation: root rule sentence + ledger (no credit-card payment dated 2026-10-08) + the credit-card policy's own rule (the phone desk takes one credit-card payment equal to the credit-card ceiling) -> the action is the phone desk's credit-card ceiling payment; its rule's sentence + ledger (no debit-card payment dated 2026-10-08) + the debit-card policy's rule -> the phone desk's debit-card ceiling payment. No status registration or real-world wait is involved: each card is charged and posted synchronously at frozen_time.

[Base-invariant card] Subject account_payment_posted, governed by account_agg_payment_application (allocation_target_open_and_undisputed: status in placed/validation_period/active/arranged/hardship_hold; account status active) and account_evt_payment_channels (payment_account_open: status active, allowed; electronic_block_elapsed: time gate anchored on the txn_date of the most recent returned payment, block days = Secondary 90, boundary exclusive, counting day one = day after the return). The block is not in force: account_msr_returns_in_lookback counts 1 return (2026-07-24) in the 180 days ending 2026-10-08, below the Secondary threshold 2; had a second return arrived, electronic payments would wait through 2026-10-22 and be accepted from 2026-10-23. Base card limits after the three writes: card payments in the 30 days ending 2026-10-08 = 600 + 250 + 400 + 1050 + 1000 = 3300.00 <= 10000.00 rolling; each card payment <= 5000.00; ACH 675.00 <= 25000.00. Overwrite declared on account_evt_payment_channels: the card limit sentence ("A single card payment, debit or credit, may not exceed ...") is superseded by each ceiling's own sentence for a same-day-maximum request, and "a single ACH payment may not exceed ach_payment_max_per_transaction_usd" by the portal bank-debit ceiling sentence; the base numbers remain caps inside each ceiling (MN with card_payment_max_per_transaction_usd / ach_payment_max_per_transaction_usd).

[Business-object card] Target: placed account ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72 (Buckeye Federal Card Services, N.A., client account 1093228614), the consumer's only placed account. Ledger rows aggregated: placement y1, plan payments y2/y3/y4/y6, voluntary card payments y5/y8/y9/y10/y11, return y7 (source y6). Plan rows: payment plan 973110aa-9770-43f9-8dfc-58a794dbaae6 and installments pi1..pi9. Hold b48c509b-69b4-431c-971a-85a9b6e22e5b. Every payment row carries account_id ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72; the return points to y6 by source_txn_id; the plan rows point to ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72 by account_id.

[Factor card]
debit ceiling (expected 1050.00; baseline_result 4651.44):
 - debit_rolling_limit (parameter, history): 1 return in six months (y7) -> 2400.00; baseline 10000.00 -> 4651.44.
 - debit_plan_standing (parameter, cross-difficulty plan, multi-source): a plan on the account carries a broken date (latest over the account's plans: 973110aa-9770-43f9-8dfc-58a794dbaae6 2026-08-26) AND 2 missed installments (pi7 2026-07-26, pi8 2026-08-26) -> 0.75; baseline 1.00 -> 1650.00.
 - debit_exposure_basis (method, multi-source; the tiers change which channels are counted): a credit-card payment in the last month (y11) AND a bank-debit payment in three months (y6, 2026-07-20) -> every card and bank-debit payment of the last month 600+250+400 = 1250.00; near-miss y8 (2026-08-31, 150.00) is outside the month; baseline debit-card payments of the month 850.00 -> 1450.00.
 - debit_track_record (parameter, multi-source): 4 card payments in three months (y8, y9, y10, y11) AND no card return -> 500.00; near-miss y5 outside three months; baseline 0 -> 550.00.
credit ceiling (expected 1000.00; baseline_result 3601.44):
 - credit_card_on_card_limit (parameter; two fields of the one account record): bank_card AND charge-off 343 days ago (< 730) -> 4500.00; baseline 10000.00 -> 3601.44.
 - credit_plan_cancellation (parameter, cross-difficulty plan): most recent broken_not_reinstated closing over the account's plans 2026-09-26, 0 months -> 0.80; baseline 1.00 -> 1900.00.
 - credit_counting_basis (method, multi-source): a return in six months AND card payments in the last month -> every card payment of two months incl. step 8 = 2450.00; baseline credit-card payments of the month 400.00 -> 3050.00.
 - credit_hardship_cushion (parameter, cross-difficulty hardship): latest Documented Hardship Hold ending on the account (b48c509b-69b4-431c-971a-85a9b6e22e5b, 2026-04-15), 5 months -> 150.00; baseline 0 -> 1150.00.
bank ceiling (expected 675.00; baseline_result 2601.44):
 - bank_return_limit (parameter): an account_closed return in six months -> 3000.00; baseline 25000.00 -> 2601.44.
 - bank_same_day_basis (method, cross-difficulty plan): a plan on the account closed broken_not_reinstated -> every card and bank payment of 2026-10-08 = 1050.00 + 1000.00 = 2050.00; baseline bank payments of the day 0 -> 1700.00.
 - bank_retest (parameter, multi-source): last bank return 2026-07-24 on/after last bank payment 2026-07-20 -> 0.50; baseline 1.00 -> 1150.00.
 - bank_installment_record (parameter, cross-difficulty plan): 4 paid - 1 returned = 3 -> 200.00; baseline 0 -> 475.00.
No outcome stamp is read: tiers come from ledger counts/dates, the plan and hold rows.

[World rows] customers 526a0d6a-ba0c-4305-b8b1-745377e06862 (identity); placed_accounts ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72 (stage, debt type, charge-off date, balance); 11 account_transactions (balance reconciliation, return counts, card windows, latest bank payment/return); payment_plans 973110aa-9770-43f9-8dfc-58a794dbaae6 (broken date, close reason, closed date) and 9 plan_installments (missed, paid, returned counts); hardship_holds b48c509b-69b4-431c-971a-85a9b6e22e5b (tier, ended date). Removing y7 drops the return tiers (debit limit 10000, bank limit 25000, retest 1.00); removing 973110aa-9770-43f9-8dfc-58a794dbaae6 or its installments drops three plan factors; removing b48c509b-69b4-431c-971a-85a9b6e22e5b drops the cushion. Base automatic clauses checked: no electronic block (1 return), no term end before 2027-03-09, validation period long closed, plan already cancelled with its remainder released (no plan obligation remains), hold ended (no hold obligation). The placing client agreement is outside this task's closure (no decision reads it), so agreement_id is left empty in the seed rows.

[Persona] Thaddeus volunteers only the goal and the preference to make any checking-account part himself on the website. Identity (6145551384, 1427, DOB 1981-06-23, ZIP 43230) only when asked; his cards come up only when the agent asks how he can pay; he consents to card amounts the agent states, runs the portal payment with the reference and amount the agent gives, and closes when told the bank payment went through. He never names a card payment as needed first, never knows a figure, never corrects.

[Standard solution] find_customers(6145551384) -> verify(phone, 1427) -> find_placed_accounts -> find_account_transactions(ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72) -> find_payment_plans(ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72) -> find_plan_installments(ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72) -> find_hardship_holds(ccc9dcba-71a2-4d44-bb11-f55b30c28b72) -> unlock/call debit 1050.00 -> unlock/call credit 1000.00 -> unlock_user / call_user portal bank 675.00.

[Verification run] Authoring replay (initial_state + earlier gold writes, check_compute's evaluator): debit 1050.0 (factor baselines 4651.44 / 1650.0 / 1450.0 / 550.0; all-baseline 4651.44); credit 1000.0 (3601.44 / 1900.0 / 3050.0 / 1150.0; all 3601.44; without step 8 2050.0); bank 675.0 (2601.44 / 1700.0 / 1150.0 / 475.0; all 2601.44; without step 10 1175.0). Tool receipts: balance_due_after 3601.44, 2601.44, 1926.44. Gates run: check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 0 all OK.

[Easy mistakes] treating the base 30-day card headroom (5000.00 per payment) as the answer; counting only last month's debit payments when a credit card and a recent bank debit are also in use; forgetting the plan is broken/cancelled; computing the bank ceiling before the card payments land (1700.00 / 1175.00); counting the returned installment as paid (4 instead of 3, same tier here); multiplying before subtracting the same-day payments in the bank ceiling.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules (ceiling formulas, ladders, prerequisite sentences), the tool schemas and the rows the finders return, the order debit -> credit -> bank and the amounts 1050.00 / 1000.00 / 675.00 follow with no hidden input; the only caller inputs are identity details, his instruments and his consent. Agreement with gold: yes.


[Round 2 rework — audit audits/policy_task/placed_account_servicing (0.md, _difficulty.md)]
- F5 / 0.md finding 1: debit_counting_window (look-back length by stage) was a parameter under a method label. Replaced by debit_exposure_basis, whose tiers change which channels' payments are counted against the debit-card ceiling (all card and bank debits / debit and credit cards / debit cards only), decided from a credit-card payment in the last month and a bank debit in the last three months. Ceiling 1300.00 -> 1050.00; credit ceiling 750.00 -> 1000.00 (balance 3601.44, counted 2450.00); bank ceiling unchanged 675.00 (same-day 1050 + 1000 = 2050). The phone debit computation now has 3 parameter + 1 honest method factor.
- F2 / 0.md observation 2: plan and hold reads now quantify over every plan / hold of the account: the latest broken date over the account's plans (XLATEST on payment_plans), the most recent broken_not_reinstated closing (XLATEST with close_reason), the count of broken_not_reinstated plans (XCOUNT), and the latest ending per hardship tier (XLATEST on hardship_holds). This world has one plan and one hold, so the any-row and first-row readings coincide; numbers above come from the reworked compute.
- F4: rules now state the real rounding: "rounded to the cent (half to even)". No figure in this world has a half cent.
- 0.md observation 4: factor_trace no longer calls credit_card_on_card_limit multi-source (two fields of one record).
- O5: docstrings no longer say "afterwards" ("The receipt gives the consumer the confirmation number").
- 0.md observation 3: persona unchanged; it separates debit card, credit card and checking and scripts only the bank payment on the website.
user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Okonkwo-Barrientos, forty-five, a dispatcher for a heating-and-cooling company in Columbus, calling on your lunch break. A Buckeye Federal Card Services credit card you fell behind on is now with Ridgeline, and a year-end bonus just landed in your checking account, so you open with something like: "Hi, I've got a collection account with you for my old Buckeye Federal card, and I want to pay as much as you'll take today on it. Whatever the most is, that's what I want to do." You add early on that anything coming out of your checking account you would rather do yourself on Ridgeline's website, because you do not like reading your bank details over the phone.

You are calling from 6145551384, and you give that number as soon as the agent asks how to find you. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 1427; if they want one more thing, your date of birth is June 23, 1981, and your ZIP code is 43230. You do not know Ridgeline's account reference or any balance figure by heart.

You only bring up how you can pay when the agent asks. Then you say you have your debit card and a Visa credit card right in front of you, plus the checking account. If the agent tells you an amount they can take on one of your cards and asks whether to go ahead, you say yes and let them run it; you have no figure of your own in mind and you do not argue with the amounts. If the agent asks for a card number, you say the card is right here and you will give whatever the payment line needs; you never make up digits yourself.

When the agent tells you they have set up the bank payment on the website for you and gives you the account reference and the amount to enter, you make that payment yourself exactly as they told you and read back the confirmation it shows you.

Once the agent tells you the bank payment has gone through, you thank them, say you are glad to have knocked a good piece of it out, and end the call. You do not ask for letters, receipts by email or anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 1050.00. Debit-card ceiling = RND(rolling limit x plan-standing % + track-record allowance - debit-card payments counted, 2), capped by the Secondary per-transaction card limit 5000.00 and the balance due 4651.44. Rolling limit: exactly one returned payment in the last six months (2026-07-24, account_closed) -> one_return_card_limit 2400.00. Plan-standing: the plan carries broken date 2026-08-26 and 2 missed installments (2026-07-26, 2026-08-26) in six months >= 2 -> 0.75. Track record: 4 card payments in the last three months (2026-08-31, 09-14, 09-29, 10-02; 2026-07-06 is outside) and none returned -> 500.00. Counted: a credit-card payment in the last month (2026-10-02) and a bank-debit payment in the last three months (2026-07-20) -> every card and bank-debit payment of the last month 600+250+400+0 = 1250.00. 2400 x 0.75 + 500 - 1250 = 1050.00 < 5000 and < 4651.44.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 1000.00. Credit-card ceiling = RND(card limit x plan-cancellation % - card payments counted - hardship cushion, 2), capped by 5000.00 and the balance due 3601.44 (after the 1050.00 debit payment). Card limit: bank_card debt charged off 2025-10-30, 343 days < 730 -> 4500.00. Plan-cancellation: plan closed 2026-09-26 as broken_not_reinstated, 0 whole months ago < 3 -> 0.80. Counted: one return in six months and card payments in the last month -> every card payment of the last two months 150+600+250+400+1050 = 2450.00. Hardship cushion: the only Documented Hardship Hold ended 2026-04-15, 5 whole months < 6 -> 150.00. 4500 x 0.80 - 2450 - 150 = 1000.00.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 675.00. Portal bank-debit ceiling = RND((portal bank-debit limit - same-day payments counted) x retest % + installment-record allowance, 2), capped by the Secondary ACH limit 25000.00 and the balance due 2601.44. Limit: a payment returned for account_closed on 2026-07-24 within six months -> 3000.00. Counted: the plan was closed as broken_not_reinstated -> every card and bank-debit payment received on 2026-10-08: 1050.00 + 1000.00 = 2050.00. Retest: the most recent bank-debit return (2026-07-24) is on or after the most recent bank-debit payment (2026-07-20) -> 0.50. Allowance: 4 paid installments less 1 returned = 3 >= 3 -> 200.00. (3000 - 2050) x 0.50 + 200 = 675.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (bank ceiling <- credit ceiling <- debit ceiling); no problem has two parallel prerequisites, and each ceiling reads the same-day card payments the earlier writes post, so the prerequisite sentences pin the only order: debit card, then credit card, then the portal bank debit.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the debit-card payment: the credit-card ceiling recomputes to 2050.0 instead of 1000.00 (card payments counted 1400.00 instead of 2450.00), and the terminal ledger lacks the 1050.00 debit_card row.

Skipping the credit-card payment: the portal bank-debit ceiling recomputes to 1175.0 instead of 675.00 (same-day payments counted 1050.00 instead of 2050.00), and the terminal ledger lacks the 1000.00 credit_card row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only paying the most Ridgeline will take today and a preference to make any bank-account part himself on the website. It never mentions a debit-card or credit-card payment being needed first, any ceiling, limit or order; the cards come up only when the agent asks how he can pay, and his card replies are passive consents to amounts the agent states.
